title: Deliver pending interventions at the next turn boundary
action: Plan Phase 2, second half (per c80debd7): the target session READS its interventions at the NEXT turn boundary — never mid-turn. Find the existing hook that already injects content at the user-prompt/turn boundary (read hooks/ for the UserPromptSubmit-path handler that today emits the bee preamble lines) and extend it: when the calling session has undelivered intervention/escalation rows (via the sup-5 pending surface, in-process, not shelling out), append them as short lines to the hook's existing output and mark them delivered. Ordinary interventions surface to the HUMAN only in reports — the hook line addresses the AGENT session (an open question, no assertion of fault). Danger-class handling stays out of this cell except: an escalation row's line is prefixed so it reads as urgent. Tests at the existing hook test seams: a pending row for this session appears once in the next hook output and is marked delivered; a delivered row never repeats; a row for another session does not leak; zero rows adds zero lines. Regen deferred to the wave barrier.
